## About
Rod Roofing is a family-owned and operated roofing company in San Antonio. We work on homes and commercial properties, and our crews take on projects of any size, from emergency roof repairs to full roof replacements.
Our team includes certified installers for all types of roof systems: tile, metal, low slope, flat and composition shingle. We are bonded and insured, and we are members of the Roofing Contractors Association of Texas and the National Roofing Contractors Association.
When you call, you will likely talk with Gilbert, one of the owner's sons. Our family is here to help your family.

## Services
- Roof repairs: Repairs for roof systems on homes and commercial properties.
- Emergency roof repair: After-hours and weekend emergency service is available by phone, so a problem in a storm doesn't have to wait.
- Full roof replacements: Complete new roof systems for homes and commercial buildings.
- Tile, metal, low slope, flat and shingle roofs: Our crews work on tile, metal, low slope, flat and composition shingle roofs.
- Hail and wind damage repairs: Repairs for roofs damaged by hail and wind.

## FAQ
Q: Can I reach you after hours or on a weekend?
A: Yes. After-hours and weekend emergency roof repair is available by phone.

Q: Do you help with insurance claims?
A: Our team has experience working with the insurance company on roof claims.

Q: Do you work on commercial buildings?
A: Yes. We work with both residential and commercial clients on projects of all sizes.

## What customers say
- "I had a roof leak and the ceiling was getting stains.

I was specifically looking for a roof company where the owner also does the work and therefore has a stake in doing quality work. This company is family owned; Gilbert, one of the owner’s sons, came out for the initial assessment, and the other son (I didn’t catch his name) was present as supervisor on the day of the repair.

Both days, the teams showed up on time and within the time frame they said they would.

The reason why I went with Rod Roofing is because during the assessment, Gilbert explained why the leak was happening and clearly explained what steps were needed to fix it properly. I really appreciated that he took photos, even flew a drone over the roof, and sent me those photos too, and showed me what he was looking at in the attic. I did not feel any high-pressure sales tactics, I felt like he was very reasonable. I could also tell he was used to doing things and wasn't just talk/sales, which is in contrast to a competing company that I called for a quote and that person (owner) was all bluster and talk but couldn't even handle the attic ladder and gave off shady, misogynistic vibes.

The price was reasonable for the work it required.

The team was able to complete the repair in one day. I do wish I could have gotten after-pictures and an explanation of how it went, but I trust it was done correctly because the guy that was actually on the roof during the assessment was the same guy on the roof on repair day.

Overall I had a good experience and would hire them again." (Sharon Kwee, 5/5)
